limitations: Rust suites were not run by executor or reviewer; receipt clearly limits them.
Seven Node tests were checked against unchanged pinned upstream source and original returned output; reviewer did not rerun them.
Worktrunk regression is a local real-command comparison following the upstream directory oracle, not execution of its Rust test suite.
Pattern/overlap scans are bounded, not a proof against every possible sensitive string or copyright concern.
Raw paper/discovery bodies must remain private; approval applies to the selected public receipt only.
